propositions: Completion verifier dense multi-criterion runs exhaust the full request budget on repository tools without banking any criterion verdicts, violating the incremental banking contract.

Pydantic AI executes tool batches concurrently within a single response, allowing the model to defer all record calls beyond the budget boundary despite prompt-only instructions to serialize evidence and commit.
The banking contract is enforced only through prompt text that treats ticket context as untrusted data, creating an authority contradiction that suppresses finite commitment to banking.

The completion-only wrapper policy must atomically claim one governed action per run_step, count unique evidence responses for the current unbanked criterion id, and invoke fallback met=false banking at the third response if still unbanked.

Proof: original 9895 run observed zero bank writes after 24 requests; held-out dense oracle showed bounded success 0/3 without policy, 2/3+ with policy, and simple three-criterion control banked 3/3 consistently.

The fix attaches CompletionEvidencePolicy at build_agent_kwargs to serialize evidence actions and enforce the finite banking loop, with system guidance as affirmative state machine and manifest remaining data-only.
